* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - 3-Level NPC (Closed-Loop AC Inverter via PD PWM)
* Auto-grounded net 11 due to GND:pin
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
* Removed Tt from models to prevent infinite di/dt matrix singularities during hard switching
.model SCTHC250N120G_NMOS NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=14.706 Cbd=0.6n Cbs=0.6n Cgdo=0.6n Is=1e-14 Rs=0.0085)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.001 Cjo=5e-11 Bv=750 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Stiff Split-Rail DC Link ---
VDC_TOP VDC_src_top n6 DC 500
RVDC_TOP_series VDC_src_top n0 0.001
VDC_BOT n6 n2 DC 500
* CRITICAL FIX: Anchor the NPC midpoint to control ground to prevent floating matrix singularities
R_GND_ANCHOR n6 0 1m
* --- Closed-Loop AC Voltage Controller (PI + Feed-forward) ---
* Target 400V peak, 50Hz sine wave
V_ref_target n_ref_target 0 SIN(0 400 50)
* control block SUM_E (sum)
BSUM_E n_err 0 V='V(n_ref_target)-V(n10)+V(n6)'
* control block KP (gain)
BKP n_p 0 V='2*V(n_err)'
* control block INT (integrator)
BINT_I 0 n_pi_int I='0.1*V(n_err)-10*max(V(n_pi_int)-1e+09,0)+10*max(-1e+09-V(n_pi_int),0)'
CINT_X n_pi_int 0 0.001 IC=0
RINT_X n_pi_int 0 1e12
* control block SUM_C (sum)
BSUM_C n_ctrl_sum 0 V='V(n_p)+V(n_pi_int)+V(n_ref_target)'
* control block K_NORM (gain)
BK_NORM n_ctrl_raw 0 V='(1/500)*V(n_ctrl_sum)'
* control block LIM_REF (limiter)
BLIM_REF n_ref 0 V='min(max(V(n_ctrl_raw),-0.98),0.98)'
* control block CAR_UP (carrier)
VCAR_UP_CAR n_tri_up 0 PULSE(0 1 0 5e-05 5e-05 0 0.0001)
* control block CAR_LOW (carrier)
VCAR_LOW_CAR n_tri_low 0 PULSE(-1 0 0 5e-05 5e-05 0 0.0001)
* control block CMP_SW1 (comparator)
BCMP_SW1 n_PWM1_int 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(n_ref)-V(n_tri_up)-0.01)/0.0002)))'
* control block CMP_SW3 (comparator)
BCMP_SW3 n_PWM3_int 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(n_tri_up)-V(n_ref)-0.01)/0.0002)))'
* control block CMP_SW2 (comparator)
BCMP_SW2 n_PWM2_int 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(n_ref)-V(n_tri_low)-0.01)/0.0002)))'
* control block CMP_SW4 (comparator)
BCMP_SW4 n_PWM4_int 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(n_tri_low)-V(n_ref)-0.01)/0.0002)))'
* Error calculation (Reference - Actual Load Voltage relative to midpoint)
* Continuous-Time PI Controller (Aggressive Tuning)
.ic V(n_pi_int)=0
* Control Effort: PI Output + Voltage Feed-forward (normalized to +/- 1)
* Anti-Windup / Modulation Clamp
* 10kHz Triangle Carriers (Upper: 0 to 1, Lower: -1 to 0)
* Smooth PWM Generation (Phase Disposition) with 500ns Dead-Time
* 10kHz Carrier slope is 20,000 V/s. A 0.01V offset mathematically creates a robust 500ns interlocking delay.
* Perfect Floating Gate Drives
E_PWM1 n1_drv n3 n_PWM1_int 0 1
RPWM1_drive n1_drv n1 100
E_PWM2 n4_drv n5 n_PWM2_int 0 1
RPWM2_drive n4_drv n4 100
E_PWM3 n7_drv n8 n_PWM3_int 0 1
RPWM3_drive n7_drv n7 100
E_PWM4 n9_drv n2 n_PWM4_int 0 1
RPWM4_drive n9_drv n9 100
* --- NPC Power Stage ---
VC1_SENSE n0 n_C1_sense 0
LC1_ESL n_C1_sense n_C1_esl 1e-10
RC1_ESR n_C1_esl n_C1_esr 0.005
C1 n_C1_esr n6 0.001 IC=500
RC1_LEAK n0 n6 6.5e+06
VC2_SENSE n6 n_C2_sense 0
LC2_ESL n_C2_sense n_C2_esl 1e-10
RC2_ESR n_C2_esl n_C2_esr 0.005
C2 n_C2_esr n2 0.001 IC=500
RC2_LEAK n6 n2 6.5e+06
VSW1_SENSE n0 n_SW1_dsense 0
MSW1 n_SW1_dsense n1 n3 n3 SCTHC250N120G_NMOS
VSW2_SENSE n3 n_SW2_dsense 0
MSW2 n_SW2_dsense n4 n5 n5 SCTHC250N120G_NMOS
VSW3_SENSE n5 n_SW3_dsense 0
MSW3 n_SW3_dsense n7 n8 n8 SCTHC250N120G_NMOS
VSW4_SENSE n8 n_SW4_dsense 0
MSW4 n_SW4_dsense n9 n2 n2 SCTHC250N120G_NMOS
VD_CLAMP_P_SENSE n6 n_D_CLAMP_P_sense 0
RD_CLAMP_P_SENSE_DAMP n_D_CLAMP_P_sense n_D_CLAMP_P_damp 0.001
D_CLAMP_P n_D_CLAMP_P_damp n3 Dmodel
VD_CLAMP_N_SENSE n8 n_D_CLAMP_N_sense 0
RD_CLAMP_N_SENSE_DAMP n_D_CLAMP_N_sense n_D_CLAMP_N_damp 0.001
D_CLAMP_N n_D_CLAMP_N_damp n6 Dmodel
* --- LC Filter and Load ---
VL_FILT_SENSE n5 n_L_FILT_sense 0
RL_FILT_ESR n_L_FILT_sense n_L_FILT_ser 0.0005
L_FILT n_L_FILT_ser n10 0.002
CL_FILT_par n5 n10 5e-11
RL_FILT_core n5 n10 1e+06
VC_FILT_SENSE n10 n_C_FILT_sense 0
LC_FILT_ESL n_C_FILT_sense n_C_FILT_esl 1e-10
RC_FILT_ESR n_C_FILT_esl n_C_FILT_esr 0.01
C_FILT n_C_FILT_esr n6 4.7e-05
RC_FILT_LEAK n10 n6 6e+11
VR_LOAD_SENSE n10 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
LR_LOAD_PL n_R_LOAD_sense n_R_LOAD_mid 1e-08
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_mid n6 1.6

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - 3-Level NPC (Closed-Loop AC Inverter via PD PWM)
* Auto-grounded net 11 due to GND:pin
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4

* ---- Key simulation parameters (for reference & manual editing) ----
.param VDC_TOP_voltage = 500      $ Input voltage (V)
.param VDC_TOP_Rs = 0.001      $ Source series resistance (Ohm)
.param VDC_BOT_voltage = 500      $ Input voltage (V)
.param VDC_BOT_Rs = 0      $ Source series resistance (Ohm)
.param R_GND_ANCHOR_R = 1m      $ Resistance (Ohm)
.param V_ref_target_Rs = 0      $ Source series resistance (Ohm)
.param PWM1_drive_R = 100      $ Resistance (Ohm)
.param PWM2_drive_R = 100      $ Resistance (Ohm)
.param PWM3_drive_R = 100      $ Resistance (Ohm)
.param PWM4_drive_R = 100      $ Resistance (Ohm)
.param C1_C = 0.001      $ Capacitance (F)
.param C1_ESR = 0.005      $ ESR (Ohm)
.param C2_C = 0.001      $ Capacitance (F)
.param C2_ESR = 0.005      $ ESR (Ohm)
.param L_FILT_L = 0.002      $ Inductance (H)
.param L_FILT_DCR = 0.0005      $ Winding resistance (Ohm)
.param C_FILT_C = 4.7e-05      $ Capacitance (F)
.param C_FILT_ESR = 0.01      $ ESR (Ohm)
.param R_LOAD_R = 1.6      $ Resistance (Ohm)
.param R_LOAD = 1.6      $ Load resistance (Ohm)
* Estimated Iload = Vout / R_LOAD  (check simulation results for actual Vout)

* Removed Tt from models to prevent infinite di/dt matrix singularities during hard switching
.model SCTHC250N120G_NMOS NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=14.706 Cbd=0.6n Cbs=0.6n Cgdo=0.6n Is=1e-14 Rs=0.0085)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.001 Cjo=5e-11 Bv=750 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Stiff Split-Rail DC Link ---
VDC_TOP VDC_src_top n6 DC 500
RVDC_TOP_series VDC_src_top n0 0.001
VDC_BOT n6 n2 DC 500
* CRITICAL FIX: Anchor the NPC midpoint to control ground to prevent floating matrix singularities
R_GND_ANCHOR n6 0 1m
* --- Closed-Loop AC Voltage Controller (PI + Feed-forward) ---
* Target 400V peak, 50Hz sine wave
V_ref_target n_ref_target 0 SIN(0 400 50)
* control block SUM_E (sum)
BSUM_E n_err 0 V='V(n_ref_target)-V(n10)+V(n6)'
* control block KP (gain)
BKP n_p 0 V='2*V(n_err)'
* control block INT (integrator)
BINT_I 0 n_pi_int I='0.1*V(n_err)-10*max(V(n_pi_int)-1e+09,0)+10*max(-1e+09-V(n_pi_int),0)'
CINT_X n_pi_int 0 0.001 IC=0
RINT_X n_pi_int 0 1e12
* control block SUM_C (sum)
BSUM_C n_ctrl_sum 0 V='V(n_p)+V(n_pi_int)+V(n_ref_target)'
* control block K_NORM (gain)
BK_NORM n_ctrl_raw 0 V='(1/500)*V(n_ctrl_sum)'
* control block LIM_REF (limiter)
BLIM_REF n_ref 0 V='min(max(V(n_ctrl_raw),-0.98),0.98)'
* control block CAR_UP (carrier)
VCAR_UP_CAR n_tri_up 0 PULSE(0 1 0 5e-05 5e-05 0 0.0001)
* control block CAR_LOW (carrier)
VCAR_LOW_CAR n_tri_low 0 PULSE(-1 0 0 5e-05 5e-05 0 0.0001)
* control block CMP_SW1 (comparator)
BCMP_SW1 n_PWM1_int 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(n_ref)-V(n_tri_up)-0.01)/0.0002)))'
* control block CMP_SW3 (comparator)
BCMP_SW3 n_PWM3_int 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(n_tri_up)-V(n_ref)-0.01)/0.0002)))'
* control block CMP_SW2 (comparator)
BCMP_SW2 n_PWM2_int 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(n_ref)-V(n_tri_low)-0.01)/0.0002)))'
* control block CMP_SW4 (comparator)
BCMP_SW4 n_PWM4_int 0 V='0+15*(0.5*(1+tanh((V(n_tri_low)-V(n_ref)-0.01)/0.0002)))'
* Error calculation (Reference - Actual Load Voltage relative to midpoint)
* Continuous-Time PI Controller (Aggressive Tuning)
.ic V(n_pi_int)=0
* Control Effort: PI Output + Voltage Feed-forward (normalized to +/- 1)
* Anti-Windup / Modulation Clamp
* 10kHz Triangle Carriers (Upper: 0 to 1, Lower: -1 to 0)
* Smooth PWM Generation (Phase Disposition) with 500ns Dead-Time
* 10kHz Carrier slope is 20,000 V/s. A 0.01V offset mathematically creates a robust 500ns interlocking delay.
* Perfect Floating Gate Drives
E_PWM1 n1_drv n3 n_PWM1_int 0 1
RPWM1_drive n1_drv n1 100
E_PWM2 n4_drv n5 n_PWM2_int 0 1
RPWM2_drive n4_drv n4 100
E_PWM3 n7_drv n8 n_PWM3_int 0 1
RPWM3_drive n7_drv n7 100
E_PWM4 n9_drv n2 n_PWM4_int 0 1

VC1_SENSE n0 n_C1_sense 0

RC1_ESR n_C1_esl n_C1_esr 0.005
C1 n_C1_esr n6 0.001 IC=500
RC1_LEAK n0 n6 6.5e+06
VC2_SENSE n6 n_C2_sense 0
LC2_ESL n_C2_sense n_C2_esl 1e-10
RC2_ESR n_C2_esl n_C2_esr 0.005
C2 n_C2_esr n2 0.001 IC=500
RC2_LEAK n6 n2 6.5e+06
VSW1_SENSE n0 n_SW1_dsense 0
MSW1 n_SW1_dsense n1 n3 n3 SCTHC250N120G_NMOS
VSW2_SENSE n3 n_SW2_dsense 0
MSW2 n_SW2_dsense n4 n5 n5 SCTHC250N120G_NMOS
VSW3_SENSE n5 n_SW3_dsense 0
MSW3 n_SW3_dsense n7 n8 n8 SCTHC250N120G_NMOS
VSW4_SENSE n8 n_SW4_dsense 0
MSW4 n_SW4_dsense n9 n2 n2 SCTHC250N120G_NMOS
VD_CLAMP_P_SENSE n6 n_D_CLAMP_P_sense 0
RD_CLAMP_P_SENSE_DAMP n_D_CLAMP_P_sense n_D_CLAMP_P_damp 0.001
D_CLAMP_P n_D_CLAMP_P_damp n3 Dmodel
VD_CLAMP_N_SENSE n8 n_D_CLAMP_N_sense 0

* --- LC Filter and Load ---

L_FILT n_L_FILT_ser n10 0.002

RL_FILT_core n5 n10 1e+06
VC_FILT_SENSE n10 n_C_FILT_sense 0
LC_FILT_ESL n_C_FILT_sense n_C_FILT_esl 1e-10
RC_FILT_ESR n_C_FILT_esl n_C_FILT_esr 0.01
C_FILT n_C_FILT_esr n6 4.7e-05
